name: redfin/search
description: Search Redfin home listings by region, map bounds or search URL with price, beds, baths, size, status and property type filters, returning address, price and listing details.

url.description: Redfin city, ZIP, county or neighborhood search URL. Existing URL filters are retained unless overridden. Supply one location: a region URL, region_id with region_type, or map_bounds.

sort.description: Result ordering. Defaults to recommended when no URL is supplied.

limit.description: Maximum listings returned. Narrow the region or map bounds when results reach this limit. The response does not advertise pagination or a total count. If search_information.possibly_truncated is true, narrow the location or filters.

status.description: Listing status. Defaults to for_sale when no URL is supplied.

timeout.description: Seconds the data source may spend before giving up (max 50, default 50). A timed-out call is not billed.

max_sqft.description: Maximum interior area in square feet.

min_sqft.description: Minimum interior area in square feet.

max_price.description: Maximum listing price in US dollars.

min_price.description: Minimum listing price in US dollars.

region_type.description: Region kind: 1 neighborhood, 2 ZIP region, 5 county, 6 city, 11 state. A ZIP region identifier differs from the ZIP code. Use a Redfin ZIP search URL if the region identifier is unknown.

property_type.description: Restrict results to one property type.

sold_within_days.description: Sold listings from the last N days; requires status=sold. Defaults to 180 for sold searches.

readme:
# Redfin Search

Search Redfin home listings by region, map bounds or search URL with price, beds, baths, size, status and property type filters, returning address, price and listing details.
